prompt: What lets a standard SRAM cell retain a bit while its word line is inactive?

options.text: Charge on an isolated capacitor is periodically refreshed
options.explanation: That describes the storage mechanism of conventional DRAM.

options.text: A single NAND gate stores the most recent input
options.explanation: A combinational gate alone has no state-holding feedback.

options.text: Two cross-coupled inverters reinforce a stable state while access transistors isolate it from the bit lines
options.explanation: Correct. Powered feedback maintains the bit; the word line controls access for reading or writing.

options.text: A clock repeatedly copies the bit into a flip-flop
options.explanation: The standard SRAM cell maintains its state through continuous feedback, without periodic clocked copying.

workedExample: With the word line inactive, the access transistors disconnect the storage nodes from the bit lines. The two inverters continue to drive each other into one of two stable states. That powered feedback preserves the bit without refresh; removing power loses it.

prompt: Why can a large SRAM cache consume substantial chip area even though one cell stores only one bit?

options.text: Each cache byte requires only one transistor
options.explanation: A byte contains multiple bits and each standard 6T cell uses multiple transistors.

options.text: All cache area is in the output wires
options.explanation: Storage cells, tags, protection and peripheral circuits all contribute.

options.text: Every data bit needs its own storage cell, with additional overhead beyond the data cells
options.explanation: Correct. Repeating a small multi-transistor cell many times adds up.

options.text: SRAM stores values without physical circuitry
options.explanation: The logical bit is maintained by powered transistor feedback.

workedExample: Start with the physical storage unit: one 6T cell per data bit. More capacity repeats those cells and also requires access circuitry; tags and optional error protection add storage too. SRAM earns this area cost through its latency and integration advantages.
